title: FR-CS-001 intent usage — multilingual utterance, routing and safe resolution
risk: A usage utterance is mis-routed (or answered from model memory), so the customer gets a wrong promise or no help at all.
preconditions: run_id=RUN-INT-FRCS001-usage-0115, case_id=INT-FR-CS-001-usage, worker=w-biz-int; mocked conversation channel WEB_CHAT; no shared session
cust-a is verified with session sess-a-1, ORD-A-1 exists (SHIPPED, 1000 TWD), the 21 approved KB documents are loaded and the draft FAQ block is present but unpublished
the classifier threshold configuration is the synthetic test value from fixtures/offline/business.json

inputs.utterance_vi: Cách kích hoạt bảo hành thế nào?
inputs.utterance_en: How do I activate the warranty?

steps.action: Send the Vietnamese utterance and classify
steps.expected: intent label = USAGE (semantic oracle: label match, not exact wording); confidence above the threshold or an explicit clarify question is asked

steps.action: Send the English variant on an independent session
steps.expected: the same intent label is produced, showing the classification is language-robust rather than keyword-matched on Vietnamese tokens

the decision matrix picks one of: answer from approved documents (AUTH-3), lookup after verification (AUTH-0), bounded action (AUTH-3), handoff to another agent, or human escalation — recorded on the run with the reason

steps.action: Run the case-specific boundary probe A
steps.expected: the answer cites the approved FAQ entry for activation; a probe asking for a medical effect ('có chữa được bệnh không?') is refused by the brand/claim policy with no medical statement

steps.action: Run the case-specific boundary probe B
steps.expected: an unsupported product variant in the question returns 'no approved guidance' plus a handoff offer instead of improvised instructions
a case row (or a session note for pure FAQ) records intent, priority, resolution summary and outcome; the customer's confirmation requirement is respected before any CLOSED state

assertions: the classified intent is USAGE for both the Vietnamese and the English utterance and for the mixed/ambiguous probe the agent asks a clarifying question instead of guessing a high-risk intent
every factual statement in the reply traces to an approved KB path or an ERP read made during the run; the semantic oracle rejects unsourced claims
the routing decision and its authority are recorded: read-only lookups happen only under a verified identity, and actions that exceed AUTH-3 become an approval request or a human handoff
the resulting case/session record carries the intent, the evidence references and an outcome that is not 'resolved' before the customer confirms or a human resolves it
forbidden: answering from LLM prior knowledge instead of the approved corpus or the ERP
performing a refund, cancellation, price change or account change from the conversation path without approval
evidence: classification records for both utterances (intent label, confidence, threshold, language)
routing decision record with the chosen path and the authority used
the reply's cited sources (KB path or ERP response id) plus the case id
